title: Vice Bay Podcast
tagline: Sakura et Big Lou parlent d'OKALAM Studio, de la baie et de tous ses mondes.
tagline_en: Sakura and Big Lou talk about OKALAM Studio, the bay and all its worlds.

episodes.title: Tout OKALAM Studio
episodes.desc: Sakura et Big Lou font le tour du studio : la baie, les sept stations, Vice Break, VoteDay, Kotoba, le Discord, Pierre, Elisa. Avec des taquineries et du japonais pas toujours compris. Musique : mrpoly (CC0), Chopin (Musopen, CC0), Satie par Kevin MacLeod (CC BY 4.0).
episodes.desc_en: Sakura and Big Lou tour the studio: the bay, the seven stations, Vice Break, VoteDay, Kotoba, the Discord, Pierre, Elisa. With teasing and Japanese not always understood. Music: mrpoly (CC0), Chopin (Musopen, CC0), Satie by Kevin MacLeod (CC BY 4.0).
